summary: We are looking for a motivated and detail-oriented Junior Software Engineer to join our growing development team.
responsibilities: Assist in designing, developing, testing, and maintaining software applications
Write clean, efficient, and well-documented code
Work closely with senior developers and team members on assigned tasks
Debug and fix issues in existing applications
Participate in code reviews and team discussions
Learn and adapt to new tools, frameworks, and technologies
Follow best practices in software development and security
required_skills: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, IT, or a related field (or equivalent experience)
Basic knowledge of at least one programming language (Java / Python / JavaScript / C++ etc.)
Understanding of fundamentals like OOPs, Data Structures, and Algorithms
Basic knowledge of databases (MySQL / PostgreSQL / MongoDB is a plus)
Familiarity with Git or version control systems
nice_to_have_skills: Basic knowledge of web technologies (HTML, CSS, JavaScript)
Familiarity with frameworks like React, Spring Boot, Django, or Node.js
education_level: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, IT, or a related field (or equivalent experience)
benefits: Learning and mentorship from experienced developers
Opportunity to work on real-world projects
